recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed unless a future terminology decision intentionally revises the general Coding.version date-fallback guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-3100 is a Published FHIR-core vocab change request resolved Persuasive with Modification for DSTU1. It requested guidance on Coding.version recommending the FHIR date of official publication when a terminology does not define its own code system version string.
initial_application: The Jira comments cite svn revision 3019. Git-svn commit 61b47035aac763f1d2b236b021343a7a9ff15e2a, "task 3100: note about code system versions", added the requested sentence to source/datatypes/coding.xml. A later terminology refactor in 1120eb61d0d267aae58f1da321cd5c9286dbff1d added consistent CodeSystem versioning guidance without removing the Coding.version text.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Coding as an active datatype, so source/datatypes/coding.xml is current build input. The current Coding.version row contains the FHIR-3100 recommendation, and source/codesystem/codesystem-notes.xml has parallel guidance. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later FHIR-core reversal; FHIR-41442 and the related SNOMED edition thread are later THO/UTG-specific background and do not change this core rule.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source hunk was necessary because the current active source already satisfies FHIR-3100.
